metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a richer footer, a crab buddy above the prompt, a compaction that beats the cache going cold, and a live graph of your agent loop.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A footer showing the model and effort, how full the context window is, and the prompt cache, with one-click compact and clear

plugins.name: crab-buddy
plugins.description: A pixel-art Claude crab above the prompt that works, thinks, cheers and sleeps with the session, with a small crab for each subagent, dressed for its kind of work

plugins.name: warm-compact
plugins.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache goes cold, or keeps the cache warm while you are away, and tallies what it saved. Two chips under the prompt turn each off or on for a session

plugins.name: loop-graph
plugins.description: Live graph of any project's agent loop in a side pane: the step at work, the path the run takes, each agent sent with its time and share of context, the commands running. /loop-graph:setup maps your project's loop
